verdicts.title: Boolean lattices in finite alternating and symmetric groups
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Given a group $G$ and a subgroup $H$, we let $\mathcal{O}_G(H)$ denote the lattice of subgroups of $G$ containing $H$. This paper provides a classification of the subgroups $H$ of $G$ such that $\mathcal{O}_{G}(H)$ is Boolean of rank at least $3$, when $G$ is a finite alternating or symmetric group. verdicts.title: Survey on Cremona groups from a median geometric point of view
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: This expository article builds on lecture notes from a minicourse entitled "Cremona groups and CAT(0) cube complexes" and given by the author as part of the 2023 Riverside Workshop on Geometric Group Theory. It presents recent constructions of actions of Cremona groups on median graphs aimed at both geometric group theorists and algebraic geometers.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract describes actions of Cremona groups on median graphs/CAT(0) cube complexes, an expository survey in geometric group theory. It says nothing about boolean circuit size, d-regular graphs, or any complexity-theoretic correlation.
